name: pi-tool-guard
description: Pi extension with two values: it runs an expensive bash command once and keeps its full log so the agent reads any slice instead of re-running, and it repairs LLM tool calls — argument aliases for edit/write/read plus trailing head/tail/grep pipeline extr
